LEFT JOIN TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP ON WP.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND WP.SITE_CD = A.SITE_CD AND WP.USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND WP.WORK_YMD = A.WORK_YMD
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT E.CMPNY_CD , E.SITE_CD , E.SCH_CD , E.APPLY_DATE , E.FST_SCH_STR_TIME , E.FST_SCH_END_TIME , E.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , E.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME , E.SEC_SCH_END_TIME , E.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN FROM ( SELECT M.CMPNY_CD, M.SITE_CD, M.SCH_CD, M.APPLY_DATE , M.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, M.FST_SCH_END_TIME, M.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , M.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, M.SEC_SCH_END_TIME, M.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN , 2147483647 AS HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT H.CMPNY_CD, H.SITE_CD, H.SCH_CD, H.APPLY_DATE , H.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, H.FST_SCH_END_TIME, H.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , H.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, H.SEC_SCH_END_TIME, H.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN , H.HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H WHERE H.USE_YN = 'Y' ) E WHERE E.HIST_IDX = ( SELECT MAX(E2.HIST_IDX) FROM ( SELECT M2.CMPNY_CD, M2.SITE_CD, M2.SCH_CD, M2.APPLY_DATE, 2147483647 AS HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M2 WHERE M2.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT H2.CMPNY_CD, H2.SITE_CD, H2.SCH_CD, H2.APPLY_DATE, H2.HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H2 WHERE H2.USE_YN = 'Y' ) E2 WHERE E2.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND E2.SITE_CD = E.SITE_CD AND E2.SCH_CD = E.SCH_CD AND E2.APPLY_DATE = E.APPLY_DATE ) ) SCH ON SCH.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND SCH.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND SCH.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD AND SCH.APPLY_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(SE.APPLY_DATE) FROM ( SELECT M3.CMPNY_CD, M3.SITE_CD, M3.SCH_CD, M3.APPLY_DATE FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M3 WHERE M3.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT H3.CMPNY_CD, H3.SITE_CD, H3.SCH_CD, H3.APPLY_DATE FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H3 WHERE H3.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SE WHERE SE.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND SE.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND SE.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD AND SE.APPLY_DATE <= WP.WORK_YMD )
mapper.select:
/* AppAdminAttdMapper.selectMonthlyAttdRows */ SELECT A.USER_CD AS userCd , U.USER_NM AS userNm , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'NODE', A.SITE_CD, A.NODE_CD) AS nodeNm , A.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , A.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq
, CASE WHEN A.WORK_SEQ = 2 THEN SCH.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME ELSE SCH.FST_SCH_STR_TIME END AS planStart , CASE WHEN A.WORK_SEQ = 2 THEN SCH.SEC_SCH_END_TIME ELSE SCH.FST_SCH_END_TIME END AS planEnd , CASE WHEN A.WORK_SEQ = 2 THEN SCH.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN ELSE SCH.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN END AS planBreakMin
, A.CHECK_IN_DATE AS actInDate , A.CHECK_IN_TIME AS actInTime , A.CHECK_OUT_DATE AS actOutDate , A.CHECK_OUT_TIME AS actOutTime
FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A INNER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = A.USER_CD
WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.WORK_YMD LIKE CONCAT(#{workYm}, '%') AND A.WORK_SEQ IN (1, 2)
AND U.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{safeKeyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\'
ORDER BY A.USER_CD, A.WORK_YMD, A.WORK_SEQ
